collection.title: Citroen C6 2005 to 2012 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Citroen C6 Saloon 2005 to 2012 model requires a 28" wiper blade on both the drivers side and the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Side Pin arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
